scene: The machine rattles and clicks, unlocking three departures across the platform.
picture: A flat side-view along the stone platform. On the far left, a brass service elevator stands open. Left of centre stands the boy in his denim jacket and camera, beside the humming vending machine. Centre right sits a sturdy freight lift platform. On the far right, a luminous night tram idles on rails.
shown: a gated brass service elevator with open lattice doors on the far left
a heavy iron freight lift platform with glowing amber bulbs on the centre right
a glowing green night tram stopped at the tracks on the far right
